id: I12-1 amendment A2 (re-registration after an invalid validity run)
committed_before: any I12-1 LODO output: run 1 of I12_1_lodo was stopped by hand during training (22:05:24-22:06:45); it wrote no correction, no held-out row and no summary

run1.V2: passed: |RRMS difference| 0.0 on nmos_L1_W1p6 and pmos_L8_W5
run1.outcome_by_rule: invalid -> stop: fix and re-register (this amendment)

cause: the driver passed the training records to fit_v2 in sorted tag order; the stored I3-2 all-18 fold corrections were trained with the records in load order (out/research/explore/E1/real_dev records, then real_test). The record order sets the floating-point summation order of the E1 loss, and over 2000 Adam steps the members differ by up to 1.8e-3 in g. The trainer itself reproduces the stored members exactly in load order (post-run checks, single process: pmos_L2_W5 seeds 0, 1, 3 and, through the driver's train_task, nmos_L0p15_W1p6 seed 2: max |dW| 0.0)

change.training_order: every training set (V1 folds, LODO folds, full-data model) lists the records in load order (i12_1_symm.fold_train_tags over the load_records_all18 order); stored in lodo/results.json 'train_order'
change.rerun: validity, lodo, deploy, decide are run again from the start; V1, V2, V3 and every rule, threshold and contrast of prereg.json and amendment A1 are unchanged

unit_tests: tests/test_i12_1_symm.py TestFoldOrder (order kept, missing / duplicate tags raise, a different order changes the trained correction)
